desc.zh: 执掌海图与罗盘,舰队看得更远。
desc.en: Master of chart and compass; the fleet sees farther.

desc.zh: 调教帆缆水手,舰队跑得更快。
desc.en: Drills the hands and the rigging; the fleet sails faster.

desc.zh: 校准火炮,炮火更准更狠。
desc.en: Sights the cannon; shot flies truer and hits harder.

desc.zh: 船医随船,坏血病更晚到来。
desc.en: A surgeon aboard delays the scurvy.

desc.zh: 打理船体与帆具,修理花费更低。
desc.en: Keeps hull and rigging sound; repairs cost less.

desc.zh: 一锅热饭稳住士气,不满更慢滋生。
desc.en: A hot meal steadies the crew; discontent grows more slowly.

desc.zh: 一艘分舰船的船长席位。
desc.en: The captain's seat of one escort ship.
